newsitem.title: IRAQ: Turkish planes kill and injure 20 Iraqi Kurds, Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Turkish planes kill and injure 20 Iraqi Kurds, Iraq.

text.p: Turkish warplanes bombed villages in northern Iraq, killing and wounding 20 civilian Kurds, Baghdad newspapers said on Saturday.
"Six Turkish planes bombed villages in the sector of Rawanduz hitting them with rockets and bombs. The bombardment led to the killing and injuring of 20 Iraqi Kurdish civilians," the papers said.
They said the attack took place on Thursday.

Thousands of Turkish troops, backed by air power, poured into northern Iraq on May 14 in pursuit of separatist Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels who use the region as a base to launch raids into southeast Turkey.
Iraq has denounced the foray into its north calling for an immediate withdrawal. The papers said the invasion of areas in Iraqi Kurdistan by Turkey was being carried out at Washington's behest.
Arab countries at the United Nations have also condemned the incursion, saying Ankara needed to withdraw its troops at once and unconditionally.
